title: Marketing Co-ordinator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are delighted to be working with a highly successful and expanding Sheffield-based business, operating within the construction and industrial products sector, to recruit an experienced Marketing Co-ordinator.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, hands-on marketing professional who can confidently take ownership of content creation and digital marketing activity from day one. Working within a small marketing team and reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you will play a key role in increasing brand awareness and engagement across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities:
- Creating engaging content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
- Filming, editing and publishing video content
- Developing and implementing social media campaigns to drive engagement and brand visibility
- Producing marketing materials including brochures, product literature and promotional assets
- Working with sales teams to fulfil marketing collateral requests
- Monitoring campaign performance and making recommendations for improvement
- Assisting with influencer and partnership marketing activities
- Ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications

The Successful Candidate Will Have:
- Proven experience within a marketing role, ideally with responsibility for content creation and social media management
- Strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite
- Experience of filming and editing video content for digital platforms
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the confidence to hit the ground running
- Experience within a product-led, manufacturing, industrial or construction-related environment would be advantageous but is not essential

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to 35,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Office-based role in Sheffield
- Working hours of 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am to 4:00pm Friday

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Ecommerce Marketing Executive
description:
Ecommerce Marketing Executive Consumer Goods Office-Based

Want to be part of an eCommerce team that's building something exciting?

We're working with a growing consumer goods business that is investing in its eCommerce operation and looking to expand its digital presence across Amazon, Shopify and other online channels.

They're now looking for an Ecommerce Marketing Executive to join the team and play a key role in driving the next stage of online growth.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of opportunity to learn, develop and make an impact.

You'll Be Involved In:
- Amazon and Shopify content and optimisation
- Product listings, online merchandising and digital content
- Supporting Amazon advertising and promotional campaigns
- SEO, keywords and conversion optimisation
- Website and marketplace performance
- Email and digital marketing activity
- New product launches
- Competitor and market analysis
- Reporting and identifying opportunities to increase online sales

We're looking for someone with experience in eCommerce, digital marketing, online retail or marketplaces, ideally with exposure to Amazon and/or Shopify.

More importantly, you'll be commercially minded, digitally savvy, proactive and keen to develop.

This is an opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its eCommerce journey, working closely with the Ecommerce Manager and wider management team as the division grows.

If you're ready to take the next step in your eCommerce career and want to be part of a business with ambitious plans for online growth, get in touch.

Contact:

Shelley Velati

Reference: SV/45679

Location - Sheffield (Office Based)

Sector - Consumer Goods

Candidate care:

By responding to this advert you consent to Cavendish Maine processing the personal data included within this application.

If your application is successful we will contact you to discuss the opportunity in more detail, within 48 hours of receiving your application.

Should you not hear from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please be advised that if unsuccessful for this role we may keep your details in our hold file for 6 months, during which time you may be contacted for other suitable vacancies. If you do not want us to do this please call us to advise.

In the meantime, we would like to thank you for your interest in Cavendish Maine.

title: Junior AEO Marketing Executive
description:
As digital search continues to evolve, an education provider are looking for a Junior AEO Marketing Executive to support their online visibility and help optimise content for modern search experiences, including AI-powered search platforms and answer engines.

This is an exciting opportunity for an aspiring digital marketer to develop specialist skills within the emerging field of Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO).

Role Overview

As a Junior AEO Marketing Executive, you will support the creation, optimisation, and management of digital content designed to improve visibility across search engines, AI-driven search tools, voice search platforms, and answer engines.

Working alongside the marketing team, you will help ensure content is structured to provide clear, valuable answers to prospective learners and stakeholders while supporting broader digital marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist in creating and optimising website content, blogs, FAQs, and resource materials.
- Research search trends and user questions relating to education and training.
- Support content strategies focused on Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Search Engine Optimisation (SEO).
- Help structure content for featured snippets, AI-generated responses, and voice search.
- Monitor website performance using analytics tools and produce reports.
- Conduct keyword and audience research to identify content opportunities.
- Assist with email marketing and social media content creation.
- Ensure content remains accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand guidelines.
- Support website updates and content management activities.

Required Skills & Qualities
- Interest in digital marketing, content creation, and emerging AI technologies.
- Excellent written communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Good research and analytical abilities.
- Creative mindset with a willingness to learn.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

What You'll Gain
- Specialist training in AEO, SEO, and AI-driven search strategies.
- Exposure to modern digital marketing technologies.
- Ongoing professional development opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Clear progression opportunities within digital marketing.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive
Sheffield Full-time

Elevation Recruitment Group are delighted to be working with a high-profile organisation who are looking to appoint a Social Media Executive to join their growing Marketing team, based in Sheffield.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and digitally savvy social media professional to take ownership of engaging, platform-first content across a recognisable brand, working across campaigns, live activity and day-to-day content.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of c£27,000
- A varied and genuinely creative role with exposure across multiple social platforms.
- The opportunity to work on campaigns, live activity and commercially focused content.
- A collaborative and fast-paced marketing environment.
- The opportunity to develop your social media career within a high-profile and engaging brand.

You'll play a key role in growing audience engagement, strengthening brand presence and supporting wider commercial and marketing objectives across a broad range of social channels.

Reporting into the Content Manager, you'll be responsible for planning, creating and publishing engaging social content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Threads.

The role will involve a mixture of planned and reactive content, with responsibility for live coverage of key events and activity. You'll need to be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, reacting quickly to developments and producing accurate, engaging content under pressure.

Key Responsibilities of the Social Media Executive will include:
- Planning, creating and publishing high-quality, mobile-first social media content across multiple platforms.
- Taking a lead role in live social media coverage, including events and behind-the-scenes activity.
- Creating platform-specific content, adapting tone, format and creative execution to maximise engagement.
- Supporting campaigns, activations and commercial partnerships through effective social media content.
- Working closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver engaging campaigns and content.
- Monitoring social media performance, audience behaviour and emerging trends, using insights to continually improve content.
- Identifying new content opportunities, stories and trends that can increase engagement and audience growth.
- Keeping up to date with changes across social platforms, emerging formats and best practice.
- Supporting wider commercial, marketing and promotional activity across social channels.
- Building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to support content creation.
- Editing and producing social assets using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut and Canva.
- Ensuring all content is aligned with brand guidelines, tone of voice and relevant policies.

We're looking for a creative and organised social media professional who understands what makes content perform and isn't afraid to get stuck in.

You'll ideally have:
- Demonstrable experience creating high-performing, platform-native social media content.
- Strong knowledge of major social media platforms and the ability to adapt to changing trends and algorithms.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut or similar editing software.
- A good understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
- The ability to plan effectively while remaining highly reactive when required.
- Confidence working in live, fast-paced and high-pressure environments.
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice.
- A creative mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities and develop engaging content ideas.

Elevation Recruitment Group's Marketing division is handling this vacancy. If you're a creative social media professional looking for your next opportunity and want to work in a fast-moving environment where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.
